local m = workspace:FindFirstChild('AsuraLobbyKit') or workspace:FindFirstChild('AsuraLobbyK') local out = {} if not m then for _,c in workspace:GetChildren() do table.insert(out, c.Name..':'..c.ClassName) end return 'NOT FOUND; children: '..table.concat(out, ', ') end local parts, sa, pending = 0, 0, 0 for _, d in m:GetDescendants() do if d:IsA('MeshPart') then parts += 1 if d.MeshId == '' then pending += 1 end end if d:IsA('SurfaceAppearance') then sa += 1 end end local first = m:FindFirstChildWhichIsA('MeshPart', true) local s = first and first:FindFirstChildOfClass('SurfaceAppearance') return string.format('%s %s parts=%d sa=%d emptyMesh=%d first=%s mesh=%s size=%s init=%s color=%s', m.Name, m.ClassName, parts, sa, pending, first and first:GetFullName() or '-', first and first.MeshId or '-', first and tostring(first.Size) or '-', first and tostring(first.InitialSize) or '-', s and s.ColorMap or '-')
